summary: HPS Corporate Lending Fund filed an 8-K to disclose April 2026 regular and variable supplemental distributions per share for four share classes (I, D, F, S), payable May 29, 2026 to record holders as of April 30. It also reported March 31, 2026 NAV per share of $24.79 for all classes, aggregate NAV of $12.435 billion, and an ongoing continuous offering of up to $15.0 billion in shares, with $13.9 billion sold to date. The filing is a routine operational update on distributions, NAV, and offering status, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
